title: Metallus Announces Second-Quarter 2026 Earnings Webcast Details
summary: Metallus (NYSE: MTUS), a leader in high-quality specialty metals, manufactured components, and supply chain solutions, will release its second-quarter 2026 results on Monday, August 3, after the market closes on the New York Stock Exchange. The company will provide live Internet listening access to its conference call with the financial community scheduled for Tuesday, August 4, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET. The live conference call will be broadcast at investors.metallus.com . A replay of the conference call will also be available at investors.metallus.com . ABOUT METALLUS INC. Metallus (NYSE: MTUS) manufactures high-performance specialty metals from recycled scrap metal in Canton, OH, serving demanding applications in industrial, automotive, aerospace defense and energy end-markets. The company is a premier U.S. producer of alloy steel bars (up to 16 inches in diameter), seamless mechanical tubing and manufactured components.
